description: The Global Wind Power Tracker from Global Energy Monitor (GEM), a non-profit research organisation, gives facility-level data on utility-scale onshore and offshore wind farms of 10 MW or more worldwide. On 26 September 2026 the page counted 32,227 project phases in 166 countries and areas, 1,129 GW of operating capacity and 2,656 GW of prospective capacity. Records give location, installation type (onshore or offshore), capacity, status, owner and start year by phase, and summary tables break capacity down by country, region and year. The latest release was February 2026. Coverage is global. Access is through a free online tracker map, dashboards and summary tables, and the full data set is a spreadsheet downloadable through a short download form on GEM's site, under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. Caveats: farms under 10 MW are excluded, and plans for prospective phases change between releases. Simulation uses are exposure of wind farms to storms and icing, offshore wind build-out scenarios and resource adequacy studies. Related records: data-gem-global-integrated-power-tracker combines GEM's power trackers and data-gem-global-energy-ownership-tracker maps owners.
